story.title: Over 12 Lakh Indian Chemists Plan May 20 Shutdown Over Fake AI-Generated Prescriptions
story.summary: More than 1.2 million chemists across India are planning a nationwide shop shutdown on May 20 in protest against e-pharmacies that are allegedly enabling the use of AI-generated fake prescriptions to fulfil medicine orders. The chemists argue that AI tools are being used to fabricate prescription documents, bypassing regulatory safeguards and endangering patient safety. The protest marks a flashpoint in the broader conflict between traditional pharmacy networks and digital medicine platforms.
companies: All India Organisation of Chemists and Druggists
